newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Henry Walker buys Tubemakers assets.
newsitem.headline: Henry Walker buys Tubemakers assets.

text.p: Contract miner and engineer Henry Walker Group Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy the assets of Tubemakers Water Process Engineering Group from Tubemakers of Australia Ltd, a unit of The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd.

Henry Walker will buy the plant and equipment, patents and other rights and all shares in the relevant Tubemakers Water Process Engineering Group operating companies for an undisclosed amount, the company said.
The acquisition will be funded internally, and the deal is expected to be finalised on July 1.
Tubemakers Water Process Engineering Group designs, builds and installs wastewater treatment equipment and holds patents for proprietary technology for intermittent biological wastewater treatment.
It has operations in Australia and Thailand.

"While not significant in financial terms - the purchase price amounts to less than one percent of our existing total assets - the acquisition is attractive for its fit within our existing business and the potential to grow the value of the assets acquired," Henry Walker's managing director, Richard Ryan, said in a statement.
Ryan said Henry Walker was likely to seek a joint venture partner for the development of an Asian wastewater business based on the operations and technology of the new assets.
